cohort.purpose: Compare versioned upstream-reported conformance evidence, not measured local results, installed-version compatibility, or performance.

interpretation.absent_feature_or_profile: not_reported / not_verified, not unsupported or fail
interpretation.explicit_unsupported_features: upstream-declared unsupported for this exact report/profile only
interpretation.partial: retain skipped tests and their reasons; zero Failed does not mean full success
interpretation.release_tag: Source/reference provenance only; does not prove the exact image tested by upstream
interpretation.same_release: Same API version/channel does not equal same data plane, topology, flags, Kubernetes version, or resources
interpretation.v1_6: Not used for the selected cohort; no latest claim.
